entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element used by the network to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were previously sent in allowed NSSAI or pending NSSAI but are now rejected.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information, representing a network slice.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that is currently allowed for the UE.

entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that is pending network approval.

entities.name: Previously sent in allowed or pending NSSAI
entities.description: Condition that S-NSSAIs were previously provided to the UE in allowed NSSAI or pending NSSAI.

entities.name: Rejected by network
entities.description: Property indicating that the S-NSSAIs are now considered rejected by the network.

relations.description: Rejected NSSAI IE contains one or more S-NSSAIs.
Rejected NSSAI applies to S-NSSAIs that were previously sent in allowed or pending NSSAI.
Condition references S-NSSAIs from allowed NSSAI.
Condition references S-NSSAIs from pending NSSAI.
Condition of previously sent S-NSSAIs establishes the property that they are now rejected by the network.
